# Epicurious

> > Epicurious is a comprehensive culinary platform featuring 33,000+ recipes, expert cooking guides, ingredient techniques, and kitchen equipment reviews for home cooks of all levels.

Epicurious is a leading food and cooking website that aggregates recipes and content from Epicurious and Bon Appétit. The site serves as a complete resource for meal planning, cooking techniques, ingredient knowledge, and kitchen shopping, with a focus on seasonal cooking, meal prep, and entertaining.

## Key Topics

- Recipes & Meal Planning
- Seasonal Cooking
- Vegetarian & Plant-Based
- Cocktails & Beverages
- Ingredient Guides
- Cooking Techniques
- Holiday Entertaining
- Meal Prep
- Kitchen Equipment
- Trending Recipes
- Expert Advice
- Food Preparation
- Recipe Collections
- Bon Appétit

## Core Recipe & Menu Collections

- [Epicurious – Recipes, Menu Ideas, Videos & Cooking Tips](https://www.epicurious.com): Homepage with 33,000+ recipes, cooking tips, videos, and meal planning resources
- [Recipes & Menus](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes-menus): Main recipes and menus collection from Epicurious and Bon Appétit
- [Ingredients](https://www.epicurious.com/ingredients): Ingredient guides, technical information, and cooking techniques

## Seasonal & Holiday Cooking

- [Holidays & Events](https://www.epicurious.com/holidays-events): Holiday recipes and entertaining guides for Christmas, Easter, and events
- [31 Easter Desserts, Each One Better Than a Chocolate Egg](https://www.epicurious.com/holidays-events/easter-desserts-recipes): Easter dessert collection with cakes, cookies, and spring celebration treats
- [21 Recipes We're Excited to Cook Whenever Spring Arrives](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes-menus/spring-staff-recipe-roundup): Staff picks: spring recipes including salads, cakes, and asparagus dishes
- [31 Easy Spring Cocktails for Brunches, Parties, and Patios](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes-menus/spring-cocktails): Spring cocktail recipes with seasonal herbs and fresh produce

## Expert Guides & Cooking Techniques

- [Expert Advice](https://www.epicurious.com/expert-advice): Expert cooking guides, techniques, and ingredient preparation advice
- [13 Types of Nuts and How to Cook With Them](https://www.epicurious.com/ingredients/varieties-and-types-of-nuts-article): Comprehensive nut varieties guide with cooking tips and substitutions
- [How to Ripen Bananas Fast, Tested and Approved](https://www.epicurious.com/expert-advice/tricks-for-how-to-ripen-bananas-article): Tested methods for ripening bananas quickly for baking projects

## Kitchen Equipment & Shopping

- [Well-Equipped: New Product Reviews, Deals, and Buying Guides](https://www.epicurious.com/shopping): Kitchen equipment reviews, buying guides, and cookware recommendations

## Trending & Collection Recipes

- [The Most-Saved Recipes in the Epicurious App This Week](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes-menus/most-saved-recipes-march-2026): Weekly trending recipes from Epicurious app users
- [23 Bean Salads for Meal Prep, Work Lunches, and More](https://www.epicurious.com/ingredients/bean-salad-recipe-ideas-gallery): Bean salad collection for meal prep with vegetarian protein options
- [Stir-Fried Curry Noodles With Eggs and Greens Recipe](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/ba-syn-stir-fried-curry-noodles): Singapore-inspired curry noodles recipe with eggs and vegetables
- [Easy Fish Curry With Coconut Milk Recipe](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/ba-syn-easy-fish-curry): Thai-style one-pan fish curry with coconut milk and vegetables

## Optional: Individual Recipes

- [Extra-Creamy Deviled Eggs Recipe](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/ba-syn-best-deviled-eggs): Food processor deviled eggs recipe for creamy appetizers and parties
- [Broccoli Confetti Rice Recipe](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/ba-syn-broccoli-confetti-rice): Vegetarian main with broccoli, raisins, and almonds for meal prep
- [7UP Cake With Lemony Glaze Recipe](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/ba-syn-7up-cake): Classic moist 7UP pound cake with citrus glaze and cream cheese
- [Extra-Smooth Lemon Curd Recipe](https://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/easy-lemon-curd): Classic silky lemon curd recipe with citrus, eggs, and butter
